content.introduction: This week's economic calendar highlights inflation data, with Tuesday's release of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) and core CPI, as economists expect headline inflation to have moderated in October due to easing gas prices. The week also features several Fed officials' speeches, including Fed Governor Michelle Bowman, San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly, and Fed Vice Chair Philip Jefferson, as Wall Street looks for clues on potential interest rate hikes. Additionally, a variety of earnings reports are scheduled, including notable ones from Kemper, Life360, and Lineage.
